Method Detail

Path

public java.lang.String Path()
Gets the fully qualified path to the CNC output file that was specified in the machining applications CNC Export dialog.

Open

public int Open()
Opens the output file to receive output from this object. If ever you're output file is empty, chances are that you did not make a call to Open().
Returns:
(-1) okay, but the internal buffer will not be written to an output file. This value is returned when you select the machining applications View/Editor menu item.
(0) failure, could not open the output file.
(1) okay, succeeded in opening the output file.
